descriptions.en: Home Assistant custom integration for Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA) APIhub weather observations, forecasts, environmental indices and public warnings.
descriptions.ko: 기상청 APIhub의 기상 관측·예보·생활기상지수·기상특보를 제공하는 Home Assistant HACS 커스텀 통합 구성요소입니다.

categories_review.source: README Key Features lists village/land forecasts, air quality and pollen indices, and public severe weather warnings from KMA APIhub. Category names verified against official Core taxonomy ec18d8b25d1ee39aa8b85a72a170e42bee33228c.
